decisions.reason: As an incremental display close to the core business, its visibility only in 2018-2019 suggests it did not meet aspiration levels strongly enough to justify continued capacity use in a flat market.
The pegboard-backed cardboard display appears to have had only a short market presence, indicating results below the firm’s aspiration and making redeployment of resources the more prudent choice.
This quarter-pallet display was close to the established offer but did not remain visible beyond the early launch period, which points to insufficient performance relative to expectations.
For a large but narrowly focused producer, a short-lived eighth-pallet display is unlikely to merit retention when outcomes seem to have fallen short of acceptable aspiration levels.

Because the wooden display pallet extended the offer somewhat beyond the firm’s main cardboard focus and showed no sustained market presence, boundedly rational management would likely shift those resources elsewhere.

The media-oriented cardboard quarter-pallet display seems not to have secured durable traction after launch, so a behavioral-theory response is to discontinue it and support stronger core or new development options.
